arabic_text: وَإنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَدُوُّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنَا مِنْهُ.
transliteration: wa in-ish-tamala alayna 'aduwwuka ash-shaytanu fastanqidhna minhu
english_text: and should Thy enemy Satan enwrap us, rescue us from him!

arabic_text: أللَهُمَّ اشْحَنْهُ بِعِبَادَتِنَا إيَّاكَ، وَزَيِّنْ أَوْقَاتَهُ بِطَاعَتِنَا لَكَ، وَأَعِنَّا فِي نَهَـارِهِ عَلَى صِيَـامِـهِ، وَفِي لَيْلِهِ عَلَى الصَّـلاَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma ash-hanhu bi'ibādatinā īyāka wa zayyin awqātahu bi-ṭāʿatina lak wa'aʿinnā fī nahārihi ʿalā ṣiyāmih wa fī laylihi ʿalā al-ṣalāh
english_text: O God, fill this month with our worship of Thee, adorn its times with our obedience toward Thee, help us during its daytime with its fast, and in its night with prayer

arabic_text: وَالتَّضَرُّعِ إلَيْكَ وَالخُشُوعِ لَكَ، وَالذِّلَّةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ حَتَّى لا يَشْهَدَ نَهَارُهُ عَلَيْنَا بِغَفْلَة، وَلا لَيْلُهُ بِتَفْرِيط.
transliteration: wal-taḍarruʿi ilayka wal-khushūʿi laka wa al-dhillaẗi bayna yadayka ḥattá lā yashhada nahāruhu ʿalaynā bi-ghafla, walā layluhu bi-tafriṭ
english_text: and pleading toward Thee, humility toward Thee, and lowliness before Thee, so that its daytime may not bear witness against our heedlessness, nor its night against our neglect!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ وَالأَيَّامِ كَذَلِكَ مَا عَمَّرْتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ، هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ، وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَا آتَوْا وَقُلُوبُهُمْ
transliteration: allāhumma wajʿalnā fī sā'iri al-shuhūr wa-al-'ayyām kaḏalika mā ʿammartanā wa-ijʿalna min ʿibadika al-ṣāliḥīn alladhīna yarithūna al-firdaws, hum fīhā khālidūn wa'alladhīna yu'tūn mā ātaw waqulūbuhum
english_text: O God, make us like this in the other months and days as long as Thou givest us life, and place us among Thy righteous servants, "those who shall inherit Paradise, therein dwelling forever" (23:11), "those who give what they give, while their hearts quake,

arabic_text: وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إلَى رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُـونَ، وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ.
transliteration: wa jilatun annahum ila rabbihim raajiʿoon wa mina alladhīna yusāriʿūna fīl-khayrāti wa hum lahā sābiqūn
english_text: that they are returning to their Lord" (23:60), those who "..vie in good works, outracing to them" (23:61)!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، فِي كُلِّ وَقْت وَكُلِّ أَوَان وَعَلَى كُـلِّ حَال عَـدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَضْعَافَ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ بِالاضْعافِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih fī kulli waqtin wa kulli awānin wa ʿalā kulli ḥāl ʿadada mā ṣallayta ʿalā man ṣallayta ʿalayh wa'aḍ'āfa dhālika kulluhu bil-aḍ'āfi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household in every time, in all moments, and in every state, to the number that Thou hast blessed whomsoever Thou hast blessed and to multiples of all that, through multiples
which none can count but Thee!
Surely Thou art Accomplisher of what Thou desirest.
